name: Open Collective Europe Foundation
summary: Belgian foundation that hosts groups anywhere in the world for public-benefit work, the environment included.

evidence.quote: OCE welcomes initiatives whose activities benefit the public and align with its mission.
Groups may be based anywhere in the world.
Open Collective Europe Foundation (OCE) is the Belgian public utility foundation
Open Collective Europe Foundation (OCE) is the Belgian public utility foundation

projects.value: Philanthropic, humanitarian, environmental and civic initiatives

evidence.quote: The foundation supports philanthropic, humanitarian, environmental and civic initiatives.

value.note: one person can discuss an application; OCE assesses an exception

evidence.quote: If you run the project on your own, you can still discuss an application with OCE. Explain who will manage the collective and how the project can continue if you are unavailable; OCE will assess whether a one-administrator exception is appropriate.
Groups may be based anywhere in the world.
The administrative contribution is 10% of funds received.

min_income.value: No minimum balance or yearly amount

evidence.quote: General hosting eligibility does not require a minimum balance or a minimum annual fundraising amount.

value.note: Groups can receive grants through it, with a mandate agreement.

evidence.quote: A mandate agreement is required if your collective receives grants through OCE.

conditions.value: Normally at least two active administrators

evidence.quote: We normally require at least two active administrators

conditions.value: Nonprofit: no money distributed as personal profit

evidence.quote: Funds support the mission; they are not distributed as personal profit.

conditions.value: Donations and sponsorships must be unconditional

evidence.quote: Donations and sponsorships must be unconditional.

conditions.value: Share a draft grant agreement with it before signing

evidence.quote: Share any draft grant agreement with OCE.

conditions.value: No support for political parties or candidates

evidence.quote: Support for political parties or candidates is excluded.
Tell us what your collective does, who takes part and how the activities benefit others.
Use the OCE application page.

steps.value: First response within seven business days; it may ask for more

evidence.quote: You will receive a first response from our team within seven business days of submitting your application. This does not mean a final acceptance decision within that time. We may ask for more information or a conversation

form_asks.value: Who you are, where you work, what you do and who benefits

evidence.quote: A short description of your activities and who they benefit.

form_asks.value: What you plan to do and how it fits OCE’s mission

evidence.quote: How your work connects with OCE's mission.

form_asks.value: Who will run it, and the funding you have or hope for

evidence.quote: What funding you already have, what you hope to receive and from whom.

own_entity.value: Tell OCE first; a fund or a grant arrangement may fit better than hosting

evidence.quote: What if we already have a legal organisation? Tell OCE before applying. A fund or a specific grant arrangement may be more appropriate than standard collective hosting; this needs its own review.

value.note: its guidance doesn’t cover employing people, so ask first; it pays invoices for completed work

evidence.quote: OCE's existing guidance does not provide for it to act as employer on behalf of hosted collectives. Ask OCE about the documentation and the legal arrangement before making a commitment.
